content.title: Tracker Season 3: Everything You Need To Know
content.text: New episodes coming soon! By Joeseph McCabe | Updated 12:02 PM EST Feb 17, 2026 CBS Since its debut, Tracker has been a hit. Following lone-wolf survivalist/manhunter Colter Shaw (played by Justin Hartley), the CBS Original series wins fans with gripping adventures. Now in its third season, and back soon from its winter break with new episodes, the drama is getting a lot more personal. Read on for your ultimate guide to Tracker Season 3, including how and where to watch the show, details on the cast – and lots more. SPOILER ALERT: Plot points from Tracker Season 2 and Tracker Season 3 are mentioned below. So, like Colter, process this info, and plan your next move. Read ahead – or, stream any episode you missed on Paramount+. Get Started With Paramount+ Where does Tracker Season 3 air? CBS Tracker Season 3 airs on CBS, and streams on Paramount+. The show returns with new episodes on Sunday, March 1. New episodes air at 8 PM ET/PT, on Sundays on CBS, and can be streamed live as they air on CBS on Paramount+ with the Paramount+ Premium plan. Where can I stream Tracker Season 3? You can stream Tracker Season 3 on Paramount+. The season premiered on Oct. 19, 2025, and you can stream the first nine episodes now. Tracker Season 3 returns with new episodes starting Sunday, March 1, following a winter programming break. See below for all the watch info you need. Tracker Season 3 Return date: Sunday, March 1, 2026 New episodes air: Sundays through the season finale Time: 9 PM ET/PT Channel: CBS Streaming: Paramount+* *New episodes can be streamed live on Paramount+ as they air on CBS via the Paramount+ Premium plan, or they can be streamed on demand on the day after they air via any Paramount+ plan. Tracker Season 3 returning cast and new faces The Tracker Season 3 cast features returning series stars Justin Hartley (Colter Shaw) and Fiona Rene (Reenie Greene). Recurring cast member Jensen Ackles returns as Colter’s older brother, Russell Shaw. Also back: Chris Lee, as Bobby’s tech-wizard cousin, Randy. Returning guest stars include Wendy Crewson (as Colter’s mother, Mary Dove Shaw), Sofia Pernas, Justin Hartley’s real-life wife (as Colter’s fellow tracker, Billie Matalon), and Jennifer Morrison (as Colter’s childhood friend, Lizzy Hawking). At least one new recurring cast member is introduced: Cassady McClincy, as Reenie’s law assistant, Mel Day. How did Tracker Season 2 end? (Spoiler alert!) Tracker Season 2 ends with Colter (Hartley) returning to his hometown of Echo Ridge, and discovering that his estranged older brother, Russell (Ackles), was not to blame for their father Ashton Shaw’s murder – and that their mother, Mary Dove Shaw (Crewson) – who’d let Colter believe his brother was responsible – had some kind of hand in it. His longheld belief disproven, Colter is left shaken by the news, and points a gun at the man who revealed it to him: his late father’s friend turned murderer, Otto Waldron (played by Alex Fernandez). What happens in Tracker Season 3? (Spoiler alert!) Tracker Season 3 opens with a heart-to-heart talk between Colter and his formerly estranged big brother, Russell. Colter tries to find out why their mother lied to him, and learns that the mystery behind his father’s death is much more complicated than he ever knew. Reenie, meanwhile, is still recovering from trauma of her own. In Season 2, she was abducted, and her boyfriend was nearly killed. Fortunately, Colter came to their rescue. In Season 3, Reenie gets a new legal assistant, Mel Day (Cassady McClincy), who takes a special interest in Colter. Where can I watch all episodes of Tracker? You can watch all episodes of Tracker on Paramount+. You can binge-watch Season 1 and Season 2, all episodes now streaming, and you can catch up on the latest episodes from Season 3, too, ahead of the show’s return on Sunday, March 1.
